method: Direct visual inspection of rendered page images, with reinspection after diagram and table-flow corrections.
checks: Title/abstract and prose legible; 10 scientific content pages including references, not a separate blank title page.
Architecture diagram nodes, state loops and concatenation connections legible and uncropped.
Stack boundary, KDA recurrence, temporal coefficient and ConvGRU equations have intact mathematical glyphs and numbering.
Encoder shapes, parameter totals, 13 task-head rows and rationale table fit with no visible overlap.
Source paths, complete model hash and five references fit on final page.
No visible clipped text, overlapping body elements, orphan spill pages or missing glyphs.
corrections_made: Reduced base typography from 11pt to standard 10pt to remove two nearly-empty spillover pages.
Made long source paths breakable and table text ragged-right; eliminated every TeX box warning.
Replaced degenerate same-endpoint TikZ curves with distinct visible state-loop paths.
Ended the encoder paragraph explicitly before its table to prevent a split 'For each' sentence.
